import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
for edu in education_order:
    mask = df['Education'] == edu
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Income'], df[mask]['Total_Spending'], alpha=0.5, label=edu, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Product Category Spending
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_means = df[product_cols].mean()
product_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(product_labels)))
bars = ax3.barh(product_labels, product_means, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax3.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${width:.0f}', 
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Marital Status Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors_pie = plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(marital_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
ax4.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 5. Purchase Channel Comparison
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
channel_data = {
    'Web': df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(),
    'Catalog': df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(),
    'Store': df['NumStorePurchases'].sum(),
    'Deals': df['NumDealsPurchases'].sum()
}
channels = list(channel_data.keys())
values = list(channel_data.values())
colors_bar = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A']
bars = ax5.bar(channels, values, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Purchases', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Income Distribution by Number of Children
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
income_by_children = [df[df['Total_Children'] == i]['Income'].dropna() for i in range(min(4, df['Total_Children'].max() + 1))]
bp = ax6.boxplot(income_by_children, labels=['0', '1', '2', '3'], patch_artist=True)
for patch in bp['boxes']:
    patch.set_facecolor('lightblue')
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Total Children at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Income by Number of Children', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
